g.text: 1. Two-stage counter-current desalting: fresh wash water to 2nd stage, 2nd-stage effluent water to 1st stage.
2. Desalter pressure held above crude bubble point by PV-1009 (backpressure on D-101B outlet).
3. Wash water / brine lines class B1 (300#) where design P exceeds A2 (150#) rating - see line list remarks.
4. Transformer trip on low-low interface (SIF-107) by Electrical (XY-1007 / XY-1008 to feeder CB).
5. Line numbers: <NPS>-<fluid>-<area>-<seq>-<class>-<insulation> per CONVENTIONS; see line list CFU-000-PI-LL-001.
6. All vents / drains 3/4" min. with blind or cap; HPV/LPD to piping specification. Valve sizes = line size UNO.
7. Instrument tags per ISA-5.1; index CFU-000-IC-IDX-001. SIS functions per SRS (SIF tags shown in interlocks).
ID 3.8 m x 30.0 m T/T, AC/DC dual-polarity grids
